description: UBA - HORAIRES NAVETTES MARITIMES is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by UNION DES BATELIERS ARCACHONNAIS. Ce jeu de données rassemble l’ensemble des horaires des navettes de l’Union des Bateliers Arcachonnais (UBA) pour la période du 4 avril 2026 au 2 avril 2027.\ Il inclut les différents trajets assurés, les heures de départ et d’arrivée, ainsi que les éventuelles variations saisonnières de service. Coverage: UNION DES BATELIERS ARCACHONNAIS. The publisher named on the listing is UNION DES BATELIERS ARCACHONNAIS. Its keywords include bassin-darcachon, transports-maritimes, transports, navettes, cap-ferret, horaires. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-05-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
